Iteration kernels

Mandelbrot

z₀ = 0
zₙ₊₁ = zₙ² + c

Parameter c is retained when the critical orbit remains bounded.

local capsule · source
Julia

Fix c, vary initial z₀, and iterate the same family. Mandelbrot-space classifies connectedness behavior across parameters.

local capsule
Multibrot

zₙ₊₁ = zₙᵈ + c, usually integer d ≥ 2.

local capsule
Tricorn

Antiholomorphic sibling family, commonly expressed with complex conjugation in the quadratic iteration.

local capsule

Escape-time skeleton

function escape(c, maxIter = 500, radius = 2):
    z = 0
    for n in 0..maxIter-1:
        z = z*z + c
        if abs(z) > radius:
            return n
    return maxIter

Rendering is then a mapping from iteration/orbit diagnostics to pixels. See plotting algorithms, orbit traps, Pickover stalks, and Buddhabrot.

Newton fractal kernel

z[n+1] = z[n] - f(z[n]) / f'(z[n])

Color by which root attracts the initial point and, optionally, by convergence rate. References: Newton's method → Newton fractal.

Software path

Fractal-generating software → Fractint → creative coding / mathematical-art software. The bundle also preserves a Python Mandelbrot visualization tutorial and an image-morphology reference for post-processing experiments.

Relationship discipline: this compact library distinguishes direct mathematical families (Mandelbrot/Julia/Multibrot, Newton method/fractal) from looser computational neighbors (machine models, morphology, creative tools). For provenance and exact edge types, use the master matrix.
